scenario: [LNUL.4.10] / [LERR.1.4.11]: the twin of LNUL.4.10.builtin_trap_beside_a_type_error_yields_the_type_error. Each `max` call yields the TypeError its `len(p.body.obj)` argument raised, so the DIVIDE_BY_ZERO its `p.a // p.z` argument raised is not the call's fault and is NOT recorded -- in either argument position. In `trap_first` the trap is met first in a left-to-right evaluation, which is what makes this pin the selection rather than the order. Path: the CALL argument loop -- libds rete/eval.c eval_call (each argument evaluated with faults held), Mercury ds.eval.m eval_all (folded with ds.fault.lnul_4_2_yielded).
rules_ds:
schema Payload scope logical:
    body: Json key
    a: Int mutable
    z: Int mutable

rule trap_first:
    Payload p where max(p.a // p.z, len(p.body.obj)) > 0
->
    log info "first"

rule trap_second:
    Payload p where max(len(p.body.obj), p.a // p.z) > 0
->
    log info "second"
